title: Terror Eel
move_pattern: Cycles between Crash and Thrash. Crash deals single-target damage, while Thrash hits 3 times and applies Vigor to the Terror Eel. The hidden Stun move transitions to Terrorize, which applies a large amount of Vulnerable to all targets before returning to the Crash cycle.
notes: Terror Eel applies Shriek on spawn, reducing the player's healing received. Terrorize applies a massive 99 Vulnerable to threaten high damage. Thrash's Vigor increases the Terror Eel's damage reduction, making it tankier over time. The hidden Stun move is a transition state rather than an actual attack.
